chapter: First bass jobs in California, Chicago and the move to New York
title: San Diego hotel club: Nat Walker, the Honeydripper and Davey Lewis
summary: In San Diego he played with Nat Walker, who was replaced, and with drummer Davey Lewis.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Two weeks. He just kept giving them [Mime] stories, and then I went back to the Moemoe, the four pieces. Then my next job was in San Diego, at the -- what is it? The hotel nightclub downstairs. Ramsey owned the hotel. I'm trying to think of the club that was downstairs. What's the name of it? Well, anyway, I worked in the club, and the leader of the group was a pianist named Nat Walker. And then we had Wee Willie, the alto player that worked with the Honeydrippers, and the drummer's name was Daniels, can't remember his first name. And that was the group.

Then something happened to Nat, and he wigged out. He says, "Why didn't you all let me know that you didn't want me to be the leader of the band?" So they had to send him back to Los Angeles. They sent the Honeydripper down to take his place, and he took the band over. And the drummer left, and Davey Lewis, out of Kansas City, he was the drummer.
